module.purpose: This file implements the Next.js edge middleware boundary for request method enforcement, static-path bypasses, maintenance and signup gating, legacy URL rewrites, embed behavior, CSP headers, cookie cleanup, and telemetry collection.
module.summary: The middleware applies ordered request guards before constructing or rewriting responses. It rejects unsupported POST requests, bypasses static assets, consults edge configuration for maintenance and signup availability, rewrites legacy routing-form URLs, configures CSP and embed headers, handles installed-app redirects, clears logout cookies, and exports a constrained Next.js matcher configuration. Edge configuration failures are intentionally non-fatal, while telemetry wraps the exported middleware.
module.businessContext: This supports authentication, scheduling embeds, routing forms, maintenance operations, and security policy enforcement in the web application. Failure can expose unavailable features, break redirects or embeds, or weaken request and CSP controls.

sectionMap.name: method_guard
sectionMap.intent: Reject unsupported POST requests before further middleware processing.

sectionMap.name: static_asset_bypass
sectionMap.intent: Allow framework internals and recognized static assets to proceed immediately.

sectionMap.name: maintenance_gate
sectionMap.intent: Rewrite non-API requests to maintenance when the edge flag is enabled.

sectionMap.name: legacy_routing_rewrite
sectionMap.intent: Preserve compatibility for deprecated routing-form URLs.

sectionMap.name: signup_gate
sectionMap.intent: Return service unavailable when signup is disabled by configuration.

sectionMap.name: installed_app_redirect
sectionMap.intent: Redirect installed-app requests using and then delete the return cookie.

sectionMap.name: response_decoration
sectionMap.intent: Apply CSP and embed headers to the final response.

sectionMap.name: telemetry_export
sectionMap.intent: Wrap the middleware with the shared event collection configuration.

edgeCases.inputShape: POST request to a route outside the allowed signup route
edgeCases.behavior: Returns a 405 response and advertises GET as the allowed method.

edgeCases.inputShape: Path under /_next or ending in a recognized static image extension
edgeCases.behavior: Returns NextResponse.next without applying later middleware logic.

edgeCases.inputShape: Edge Config unavailable or get throws
edgeCases.behavior: Suppresses the error and returns undefined, allowing processing to continue.

edgeCases.inputShape: Signup API request while signup is disabled
edgeCases.behavior: Returns JSON error Signup is disabled with status 503.

edgeCases.inputShape: Installed-app request with a nonempty return-to cookie
edgeCases.behavior: Redirects to the cookie URL relative to the request and deletes the cookie.

edgeCases.inputShape: Embed URL with flag.coep=true or ui.color-scheme
edgeCases.behavior: Adds corresponding embed policy, color scheme, and embed marker headers.

errorHandling.action: Suppresses failures from the edge configuration lookup.

invariants.description: Disallowed POST requests receive a 405 response with Allow set to GET.
Edge configuration failures do not abort middleware execution and produce undefined.
Method and static-file checks occur before feature gates and response decoration.
Final non-early responses pass through CSP processing before embed processing.
Installed-app redirects delete the return-to cookie before returning.

assumptions.description: Next.js invokes the default export with a NextRequest matching the exported matcher configuration.
CSP_POLICY indicates whether CSP has been opted into; its absence selects the not-opted-in response marker.
Edge Config contains boolean values under isInMaintenanceMode and isSignupDisabled.

ambiguities.question: Does the edge configuration client obtain EDGE_CONFIG through deployment environment configuration?

concurrencyModel.notes: Each request is processed independently; the only asynchronous operation is the edge configuration lookup.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A POST request targets an API route not explicitly allowed for POST.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the method restriction and advertised allowed method.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A POST request targets the signup API route.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the sole explicitly permitted POST API route.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A request targets a supported static asset or a Next.js internal path.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures static resources bypass normal middleware processing.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A non-API request arrives while maintenance mode is enabled.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the app-wide maintenance rewrite while excluding API requests.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A signup request arrives while signup is disabled.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the externally observable signup availability contract.
Ensures login routes opt into enforced CSP rather than report-only behavior.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An installed-app request contains a return-to cookie.
moduleContractTests.then: response redirects to "/target" and deletes the "return-to" cookie
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins both navigation and one-time cookie cleanup.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A request uses the legacy routing forms path.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves backward compatibility for legacy links.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An embed route includes embed-specific query parameters.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the wire headers required by embedded experiences.
Ensures logout invalidates the session cookie.
